hypotheses.justification: Y is not required to be integral. Nothing in the statement needs this instance: fY only needs LocallyOfFiniteType, and the conclusion only mentions the stalk rings. The hypothesis is implied by the others up to nilpotents, and nilpotents do not change Krull dimension. Since h is surjective and X is irreducible, Y is irreducible, because it is the image of X. Since X is reduced, h factors through Y_red, and the factored map X → Y_red is still finite and surjective. Y_red is reduced and irreducible, so it is integral, and it is locally of finite type over K because Y is. The stalk of Y at a point is a quotient by its nilradical of the stalk of Y_red at the same point, and Krull dimension is unchanged because the prime spectrum is the same. Applying the existing argument to X → Y_red therefore gives ringKrullDim(O_{X,x}) = ringKrullDim(O_{Y_red,h x}) = ringKrullDim(O_{Y,h x}). The only places where the current proof uses integrality of Y are injectivity of h^# on affine opens (via basicOpen_eq_bot_iff, which needs reducedness) and the domain hypothesis in height_comap_eq. Both are obtained after passing to Y_red. The other hypotheses cannot be dropped. IsIntegral X is needed: X = Y ⊔ pt maps finitely and surjectively onto a positive-dimensional Y, and the stalk at the extra point has dimension 0. Surjective and IsFinite are also needed.
